description: This file defines the CodePage class that manages the mapping between code page identifiers and their corresponding encoding names, including validation and conversion functions related to character encodings used in spreadsheet processing.

classes.name: CodePage
classes.description: A utility class for handling code page conversions and validation for spreadsheet encoding compatibility.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks if a given code page name is valid and supported within the internal code page array.

methods.name: numberToName
methods.description: Converts a numeric code page identifier to its encoding name, using iconv to verify support.

methods.name: getEncodings
methods.description: Returns the full mapping of code page identifiers to encoding names.
